基層關愛
Junior care

   在香港回歸祖國暨香港特別行政區成立27週年之際，華潤啤酒聯合香港本地社企「北河同行」，面向香
   港基層家庭、獨居長者開展「基層樂融融七一派福袋」活動。本次活動共準備1,000份福袋，包含食用
   油、罐頭等生活物資，由華潤啤酒「潤雪」義工隊向深水埠地區居民現場派發，展現駐港央企的責任與
   使命。
   華潤啤酒自二零一三年開始捐款支持青年音樂訓練基金，以行動支援基金公益活動及扶助香港弱勢青
   年。




                                                                                                                       致 我 們 的 股 東 | To Our Shareholders
   華潤啤酒自二零一四年開始支持Rainbow Foundation，除了捐款支持，亦積極參加其舉辦的慈善步行活
   動，以行動支持基金及在港弱勢社群的兒童及青少年。
   On the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the return of Hong Kong to the motherland and the
   establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, CR Beer, in collaboration with a local
   social enterprise “Beihe Tongxing” (北河同行), organised the activity “Grassroots Lucky Bags Distribution
   on 1st July” (基層樂融融七一派福袋) for grass-roots families and single elders in Hong Kong. A total
   of 1,000 lucky bags, including cooking oil, canned food and other daily necessities, were prepared and
   distributed to Shamshuipo residents by CR Beer’s volunteer team “Runxue” (潤雪). This demonstrated the
   responsibility and mission of the central state-owned enterprises in Hong Kong.
   Since 2013, CR Beer has donated to the Music for Our Young Foundation to support the Fund’s public
   welfare activities and help underprivileged young people in Hong Kong.
   Since 2014, CR Beer has been supporting Rainbow Foundation. In addition to monetary donations, we
   also actively participated in the charity walk activities organized by the Rainbow Foundation to support it
   and the underprivileged children and teenagers in Hong Kong.

      產城融合
      Industry-city integration to build a beer town

         二零二四年底，在華潤啤酒成立30週年之際，以酒文化為主題的BREWTOWN啤酒小鎮正式亮相，是
         產城融合的創新典範。該項目通過對老廠區的活化改造，打造了集酒文化、品質餐飲、創意娛樂於一
         體的主題商業街區，一方面帶動當地就業及社區發展，另一方面構建滿足居民休閒消費需求的公共空
         間，將產業升級與城市煥新有機結合，充分彰顯華潤啤酒在推動產城融合發展中的社會責任擔當。

         At the end of 2024, coinciding with the 30th anniversary of CR Beer’s establishment, we formally
         launched BREWTOWN, which is themed around beer culture and is an innovative model of the integration
         of industry and city. By revitalizing and upgrading the old factory area, the project creates a themed
         commercial block integrating beer culture, quality catering and creative entertainment. On the one
         hand, it promotes local employment and community development, and on the other hand, it builds a
         public space to meet the leisure consumption needs of residents, and organically combines industrial
         upgrading with urban rejuvenation. This fully demonstrates CR Beer’s commitment to social responsibility
         in promoting the integration of industry and city development.

所 有 董 事（ 包 括 執 行 董 事 及 非 執 行 董 事 ）   All Directors (including Executive Directors and Non-executive
均沒有固定任期。董事會認為，董事會的                   Directors) are not appointed for a fixed term. The Board would like
組成應具有充分的靈活性，方能配合本集                   to retain sufficient flexibility to organise the composition of the Board

            N.V. 為 Heineken Holding N.V. 持 有 50.005% 股
            權的公司。因此，Heineken Brouwerijen B.V.、
            Heineken International B.V.、Heineken N.V. 及
            Heineken Holding N.V.被視為於1,676,338,664
            股股份中擁有權益。

      甲    綜合入賬                                  A     CONSOLIDATION
           本集團之綜合財務報告包括本公司                             The consolidated financial statements of the Group include
           及其全部直接及間接附屬公司之財                             the financial statements of the Company and of all its direct
           務報告。於年內收購或出售之附屬                             and indirect subsidiaries. The results of subsidiaries acquired

           計或截至出售生效日期止（視情況而                            date of acquisition or up to the effective date of disposal, as
           定）納入計算。所有集團內部之重大                            appropriate. All material intra-group transactions and balances
           交易及結餘已於綜合入賬時對銷。                             have been eliminated on consolidation.

           於二零一零年一月一日之前，增加                             Prior to 1 January 2010, the increases in interests in existing
           現有附屬公司權益與收購附屬公司                             subsidiaries were treated in the same manner as the acquisition
           的處理方法一致，即商譽或優惠承                             of subsidiaries, with goodwill or a bargain purchase gain being
